title: Move the spec to 1.x
description: strspc-rules is 1.x, and this repo's first release was v0.2.0. Make the next release 1.0.0. Versions stay independent of core, they do not track it.
close_reason: Merged in #28: next release is v1.0.0 via Release-As footer.

title: Squash PRs into develop to stop duplicate changelog entries
description: release-please counts a PR twice under merge commits: the commit itself and the PR title repeated in the merge commit body. v0.2.0 shows the same entry twice, as do strspc-CLI and strspc-sync; strspc-CLI moved to squash in #164. Squash into develop, keep the merge commit for promotes, and lint the PR title since it becomes the commit.
close_reason: Merged in #27: PRs squash into develop, CI checks titles (including edits, 120-character limit).

title: Release from conventional commits with release-please
description: Promotions are not tracked: realm.version is bumped by hand and nothing records what shipped. Use release-please on main, as strspc-CLI, strspc-manager and strspc-sync do: commit types set the SemVer bump, a release PR carries realm.version and CHANGELOG.md, and merging it tags and publishes.
close_reason: Merged in #24: release-please on main, archives attached from its workflow, commitlint in CI. Unproven until the first promote; needs the App org secrets.

title: Adopt develop as the default branch: CI, auto-approve, release, docs
description: develop is now the default branch of strspc-spec. CI and auto-approve only covered main, and the repo had no release flow. Align with strspc-rules: PRs into develop, develop -> main promotes, push to main tags v<realm.version>.
close_reason: Merged in #23 (d4248c5): CI on develop, release workflow, docs, auto-approve variable set to develop. First release run is unproven until the first develop -> main merge.

title: Prepare repository for going public
description: Finish the content audit, land .gitignore/beads and docs PRs, clean up description, issue #1 and stale branches. The visibility flip stays with PLB; afterwards enable secret scanning.
close_reason: Repository is public: audit clean, PRs 20 and 21 merged, secret scanning and push protection on, rulesets intact.

title: Require validate / lint and check / check on main
description: Add a repository ruleset requiring both checks from GitHub Actions, strict policy off. Needs strspc-spec#17 merged first: requiring a missing check blocks every PR.
close_reason: Replaced by one org ruleset, tracked in strspc-rules-ri6.

title: Enforce merge methods: merge commit into main, squash into develop
description: Nothing enforces the merge methods. #29 was squashed into main and cut no release, and the merge dialog remembers the last method used. A repo ruleset could allow only merge commits on main and only squash on develop. Check it works alongside the org pr-mandatory ruleset and admin bypass, and that release PRs into main can still merge.
notes: Ruleset payloads prepared, not created: creating them was denied in the session, so it needs the owner to run the POSTs. #32, #33 and #34 went into develop as merge commits, so the next changelog will show duplicates.
close_reason: Repo rulesets merge-method-main (26230609, merge only) and merge-method-develop (26230612, squash only) created and active; both listed in rules/branches for their branch.

title: SteerSpec/.claude: architect.md still calls strspc-spec planned
description: agents/architect.md says strspc-spec is a planned upstream source and not yet ready. It is now the dev.steerspec.platform realm, with component rules owned by each component repository. Update the agent text.

title: Decide which Draft rules should reach Implemented
description: fail_on is [I] and this realm has 0 Implemented rules and 6 Draft, so CI enforces none of them. Triage only, no code change.
notes: Triage against the repos, 2026-10-30. 001: complies (go.mod: manager has no SteerSpec deps, CLI imports manager, sync none) -> P. 002: complies (CLI pins manager v1.28.0, the latest release) -> P. 005: complies, strspc diff enforces it in every realm's CI -> P, then I. 006: complies on inspection (CLI src/cmd wraps manager; no full audit) -> P. 003 and 004 stay D: they say every repository, but 8 of 13 repos have no realm (.github, .github-private, .claude, homebrew-tap, strspc-pr-review, strspc-www, strspc-marketing, strspc-cloud). Published text is final, so the scope must be settled while Draft. 001, 002, 006 stay P: complying is not enough, because no CI check verifies them and this realm's evaluator is null.
close_reason: Triaged and done: 005 Implemented (#34), 001, 002, 006 Published (#32), 003 and 004 stay Draft until their every-repository scope is settled.
